title: Annotatio IV §.II open: Internal obstacles — fountains from will’s pravity and intellect’s error; many rivulets
pass_a_gloss: §. II. The latter [obstacles], you may call other Fountains, arising from the first Principles of human Actions — two common vices inhering in Intellect and Will, Pravity and Error; other Rivulets springing from the fountains named, and those more in number.
pass_b_english: §. II. The later obstacles you may call other fountains — arising from two common vices in the first principles of human action, intellect and will: pravity and error.
From those fountains spring still more rivulets, greater in number.
source_text:
§. II.
Posteriores, Fontes dixeris alios, ex primis Actionum humanarum Principiis, Intellectui & Voluntati inhaerentibus vitiis communibus duobus, Pravitate & Errore exoriturus; alios Rivulos, ex fontibus memoratis scaturientes, eosque numero plures.
notes: §.II open; Internos as Pravitas & Error fountains.
